svg.title: How ScheduleEventDag::GetTopologicalOrdering picks the next event
svg.desc: Kahn's algorithm with a min-priority queue on job index, step by step on the example DAG, compared with the Boost DFS order DagBase would give.

g.text: Only the job index is compared, so among ready events of the same job the heap's internal order decides. That order is deterministic for a DAG built the same way,

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: but it is not 'vertex order'. Reduce() calls the virtual GetTopologicalOrdering, so on a ScheduleEventDag it also uses the job-priority order.

g.text: planner_core/src/event_dag.cpp overrides the Boost sort so that earlier jobs come first. If some events never become ready (a cycle), the count falls
